reasoning: This is FairTix's lottery winner notification system. When a user wins a ticket lottery (new entry added to LotteryWins sheet), it sends a polished congratulatory email with ticket details and payment link, then tracks the email status back to the sheet. The sophisticated email template with transparent pricing messaging and 24-hour purchase window indicates this is customer-facing revenue generation. The 'continueErrorOutput' setting and dual success/error tracking show intentional error handling design.
name: FairTix Lottery Winner Notification System
businessNarrative: This workflow converts lottery winners into paying customers by immediately notifying them of their win and directing them to complete purchase within 24 hours. The polished email emphasizes FairTix's value proposition of transparent pricing and fair queues while creating urgency to capture revenue. The dual-path tracking (success/error updates) ensures operational visibility into notification delivery, critical for a time-sensitive sales process where failed notifications directly impact conversion rates.
trigger: New lottery winner entry added to Google Sheets
dataFlow: Lottery winner data (Name, Email, EventName, TicketPrice, ID) flows from Google Sheets trigger into personalized email notification, with delivery status and timestamp logged back to the same sheet

impact.reasoning: This directly converts lottery winners to revenue - failed notifications mean lost sales with no recovery mechanism since winners only have 24 hours. The polished email template and purchase urgency indicate this is core revenue generation, not just informational.
impact.failureScenario: Lottery winners never receive notification emails, miss 24-hour purchase window, tickets get released to others, direct revenue loss and customer dissatisfaction
impact.revenueConnection: Direct - failed notifications directly prevent lottery winners from purchasing tickets within the 24-hour window, resulting in immediate revenue loss

detectability.reasoning: Workflow uses continueErrorOutput and has explicit error handling that logs failures to Google Sheets with status codes and error messages, providing visibility into notification failures
detectability.evidence: Error handling via continueErrorOutput setting and Error update node logs failures to sheets, but relies on manual sheet monitoring rather than automated alerts

timeSavingsEstimate: 5-10 minutes per winner (manual email drafting, sending, and tracking) - data-driven based on email template complexity and tracking requirements

technicalEvidence.errorHandling: continueErrorOutput enabled on Gmail node with dual-path success/error logging to Google Sheets. No retryOnFail configured on any nodes.
credentials: DL School Automations Google Sheets Account (googleSheetsTriggerOAuth2Api)
technicalEvidence.complexity: 4 nodes with sophisticated email template including HTML styling, personalization, and dual-path status tracking
keyFindings: Professional customer-facing email template with FairTix branding
24-hour purchase urgency creates time-sensitive revenue window
Transparent pricing messaging reinforces company value proposition
Dual credential setup suggests organizational email/sheets separation
